mappings.rationale: Successive two-term blocks in the geometric sequence are multiplied by the square of its common ratio.
mappings.answerReason: If the ratio is r, then 91 = 7(1+r²+r⁴). Thus (r²-3)(r²+4)=0, so r²=3. The first four terms sum to 7(1+3)=28.

mappings.answerReason: Put u=log_b 2, v=log_b 3, and t=log_b x. Taking log_b gives u(u+t)=v(v+t). Since u≠v, t=-(u+v)=-log_b 6, hence x=1/6.
